description: Na₃MnO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.31 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.37 Å. Mn⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form MnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and three longer (1.70 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Mn⁵⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Mn⁵⁺ atom. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Mn⁵⁺ atom.
